name: Shell scripts (ShellCheck)
install_note: Fetch the official static binary (github.com/koalaman/shellcheck, shellcheck-vX.linux.x86_64.tar.xz, about 2.5 MB) into ~/.local/share/cockpit/tools/shellcheck/ and link it from ~/.local/bin (no root), or: sudo apt install shellcheck (an older version).
description: Check shell scripts without running them. Check runs ShellCheck, the standard linter: each finding as file(line,col) with its SC code and a link to the explanation (unquoted variables, cd without a check, missing quoting, bashisms in sh scripts, useless use of cat and many more). Syntax asks the script's own shell (bash -n, sh -n, dash -n) whether it parses at all. Habits scan reads for dangerous habits: curl | sh, rm -rf of a variable, chmod 777, eval, curl -k, a fixed name in /tmp, no set -e, a hard-coded secret, sudo inside a script. Unit check runs systemd-analyze verify on a .service or .timer file. Give a script or a folder: every *.sh, *.bash and file with a shell #! line is checked, and nothing is ever executed.

presets.label: ShellCheck (the standard shell linter)
presets.description: Every shell script in the file or folder through ShellCheck: errors, warnings and style notes as file(line,col) with the SC code and the explanation link. By default each script is read as the shell its #! line names; type shell=sh (or bash, dash, ksh) in the extra arguments to force one, for example to check a script for POSIX portability. With Fix with agent.

presets.label: Syntax: does it parse (bash -n, sh -n, dash -n)
presets.description: Asks the script's own shell to parse it without running it. Catches a missing fi or done and an unclosed quote, as file(line).

presets.label: Habits scan (dangerous patterns)
presets.description: Reads for curl | sh, rm -rf of a path built from a variable, rm -rf /, chmod 777, eval of a variable, curl -k, a fixed name in /tmp, no "set -e" (in longer scripts), a hard-coded password or token, sudo inside a script. By patterns: some false alarms; ShellCheck finds the quoting and portability faults this does not.

presets.label: systemd unit check (.service, .timer ...)
presets.description: Runs systemd-analyze verify on a unit file: unknown keys, commands that do not exist, missing dependencies, as file(line). Read only: the unit is not loaded into systemd.
